propositions: When structured parsing retries exhaust OUTPUT_RETRIES limit, the raw reply text is discarded and the failure is not replayable.
A new config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir must be added to LLMConfig and resolved via _llm_str in from_env to opt-in local artifact capture on final parse failure.

On final parse failure in _pai_structured's prompted branch, when the config key resolves to a non-empty path, write a timestamped file containing the raw reply, model id, contract name, and attempt count, then append the path to the raised error message.
The artifact write is best-effort and must never mask the original parse error; any I/O failure is swallowed and the original exception is raised unchanged.
Artifacts are rotated by count to keep at most 20 newest files per directory, preventing unbounded growth on unattended hosts.
